purpose: Test a clean-image BatchNorm statistics mismatch before proposing another gradient-training experiment
method: Reset all four BatchNorm running means/variances; make one shuffled pass over every canonical fold-training image, without image augmentation or MixUp. Update BatchNorm buffers using image-count-weighted batch statistics. Keep learned parameters frozen and dropout disabled. Then freeze all layers for clean training and validation inference.
selection: One predetermined statistics recipe, no coefficient or subset sweep. Compare with the same source models replayed on CPU. Do not replace the original checkpoints or their saved decisions.
